module: Provides the career UI with the data of the progression landing page (domains, branches, skills): titles, breadcrumbs, level/XP, unlocks, leagues and formatted missions. Also adds the 'landing page APM' button to the computer menu. A modder mainly uses it to understand the format of the tables sent to the career.branchPage screen.
notes: Without a pathId (nil, '' or 'undefined'), getLandingPageData lists the domains (branch.isDomain) with target 'landing' if they have child branches, otherwise 'skillPage'.

With a pathId, the page lists the children (target 'skillPage'), computes level/XP (career_branches.calcBranchLevelFromValue), the reward multiplier inherited from the parents and, for a branch or skill, its leagues with formatted missions.
The default domain of the suggestions is 'apm'.

getBranchSkillCardData.desc: Returns the info of a branch/skill card for the UI (name, descriptions, level, level label, max level reached, unlocked, icon, color…). Calls career_branches.checkUnlocks() beforehand.

openBigMapWithMissionSelected.desc: Opens the big map (freeroam_bigMapMode.enterBigMap) instantly with the selected mission, return route 'career.branchPage.bigmap'.

missionId.desc: Id of the mission to select.

formatMission.desc: Formats a mission for the UI: skill, id, icon, label, description, type, formatted progress, startable, preview, thumbnail, locked (not visible) and canStartFromProgressScreen ('league' type trigger).

formatDriftSpot.desc: Formats a drift spot as a mission for the UI (skill 'drift', icon 'drift02', objectives completed as stars by default).

getSuggestedMissionsForDomain.desc: Recursively walks the domain's branches/skills (excluding in-development ones) and returns up to two suggested missions: one never played (0 stars) and one partially completed (otherwise a second never played).

resolveBranchTitle.desc: Translated title of a branch (branchHeading or name); if absent or missing, returns the translated title of the landing page (ui.career.landingPage.name).

getLandingPageData.desc: Builds the whole table of the progression page: heading, description, branches, breadcrumbs, and for a branch: skillInfo, skills, leagues (formatted missions), isBranch.

pathId.desc: Domain/branch id; nil, '' or 'undefined' for the root page.

onComputerAddFunctions.desc: Hook of career_modules_computer: if the facility has the function 'apmLandingPage', adds a general button that navigates to 'career.branchPage' (pathId 'apm', return 'career.computer'), disabled until the starter vehicle is bought.
